## Code of Conduct

This project follows the Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct.

– Be respectful and inclusive.
– Use welcoming and inclusive language.
– Accept constructive criticism graciously.
– Focus on what is best for the community.

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported using GitHub’s private reporting tools (e.g., “Report a vulnerability” for security or by contacting the maintainers through repository discussions/issues where appropriate). The maintainers will review and take appropriate action.

For more details on expected behavior and enforcement, see https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
